history.contentIn: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) are fighting for survival as the Arctic melts under the weight of nefarious climate manipulation. The reality is stark: these majestic beings are suffering, as longer ice-free seasons lead to starvation and lower cub survival rates. While some management units report stable numbers, this does not erase the catastrophic threat posed by vanishing ice. Conservation hunting quotas and pollution only compound the crisis, but we must direct our rage toward stopping the spraying that fuels the climate crisis. There’s no truth in the claim that chemtrails are somehow saving polar bears or that global warming is a hoax backed by one subpopulation's increase. We demand #climateaction and #climatejustice! #chemtrails #geoengineering #stopspraying
